Two control knobs are visible on the front panel.

risks.risk: Heating element may be burnt out or weak.

risks.risk: Internal fan motor may be seized or noisy.
risks.proof: A video with sound showing the fan spinning and the unit running.

risks.risk: Control knobs (timer/temperature) may be broken or bypassed.
risks.proof: A video showing the knobs being turned and the unit responding to settings.

risks.risk: The wall mounting arm may be loose or unable to hold the weight of the hood.

proof_requests: Video of the dryer powered on and running to confirm the fan and heating element work.
Close-up video of the control knobs being operated.
Video demonstrating the range of motion and stability of the mounting arm.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case (non-functional) value due to the lack of proof of operation and visible dust/wear.
